conclusion: Static scan: no file of the 196 hash-verified locked artifacts other than nltk, none of GPT Researcher 0957c301's 364 .py files and none of the recipe's Python references TransitionParser, AveragedPerceptron, PerceptronTagger, save_to_json or save_maxent_params, so GHSA-8mgp-746c-j5xp's affected model import/export APIs are not statically referenced from the worker's code. The lock's only nltk callers are langchain-text-splitters 1.1.2 (Punkt sentence splitting; the stopwords corpus only with stopword_removal=True) and langchain-community 0.4.2 (BLEU scoring), and GPT Researcher references none of those classes. nltk 3.10.3 stays installed (GPT Researcher declares it at pyproject.toml:111) and is loaded at import through langchain_text_splitters; OSV lists it as affected with no patched release, and pathsec is on by default. The pin remains an affected version; this receipt supports the scoped allowance for this lock in tests/test_osv_lockfile_coverage.py:50-55, not a claim that nltk 3.10.3 is safe.
